// A TSX fixture: JSX, generics, template literals.
import { useState } from "react";

interface Props { label: string; count: number }

export function Badge({ label, count }: Props) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<Map<string, number[]>>(new Map());
  const greeting = `hi ${label} (${count})`;
  const handler = (event: MouseEvent) => setValue(new Map([[label, [count]]]));
  return (
    <div className={cx({ active: count > 0 })} onClick={handler}>
      <span title="a ) paren in an attribute">{greeting}</span>
      {value.size > 0 && <em>{count}</em>}
    </div>
  );
}
